links.outcome: Racial and educational group disparities in NST scores versus MoCA
links.effect: NST showed smaller racial and educational disparities than MoCA (NST d = 0.03-0.33 vs MoCA d = 0.37-0.72), though some disparity remained.
links.quote: NST tracked longitudinal cognitive change, correlated with hippocampal volume (r up to 0.28, P < .001), and showed smaller racial and educational disparities relative to standard cognitive testing (NST d = 0.03-0.33, MoCA d = 0.37-0.72).

unlisted_practices: Mapping voice features to interpretable neurocognitive domains to make AI voice biomarkers interpretable

screen.reason: The study develops and validates an interpretable neurocognitive framework (NST) for voice/speech features using LLMs/AI, testing clinical validity and equity across retrospective cohorts without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
